title: 1950201-UDS-001-00 Oil to Salt HEX
summary:
- Document is for an oil-to-salt heat exchanger
- ASME Code, Section VIII, Division 2, 2017 Edition referenced
- Location: Solana Generation Station in Arizona
- Vessels are horizontal (saddle supported, STACK type)
- Service fluids include Molten Salt and Therminol VP1
- Nozzle types, sizes, and orientations are detailed.
- Design conditions include pressure and temperature specifications.
- Live loads consider static head, vessel weight, and equipment effects.
- Operating conditions specify shell and tube side pressures.
- Fatigue analysis required due to metal temperature variations.
- Materials of construction include SA 533, Gr.B, Cl.2 among others.
- Corrosion allowances are specified for both sides.
summary_points: Document is for an oil-to-salt heat exchanger
ASME Code, Section VIII, Division 2, 2017 Edition referenced
Location: Solana Generation Station in Arizona
Vessels are horizontal (saddle supported, STACK type)
Service fluids include Molten Salt and Therminol VP1
Nozzle types, sizes, and orientations are detailed.
Design conditions include pressure and temperature specifications.
Live loads consider static head, vessel weight, and equipment effects.
Operating conditions specify shell and tube side pressures.
Fatigue analysis required due to metal temperature variations.
Materials of construction include SA 533, Gr.B, Cl.2 among others.
Corrosion allowances are specified for both sides.
Nozzles with attached piping must be designed for specific loads.
Overpressure protection required per ASME Code Section VIII Division 2, Part 9.
Additional requirements include non-destructive examination, material selection, and heat treatment.
Weld joints must be FULL Radiography examined as per Table 7.1 of the Code.
Hydrostatic testing to be performed in Manufacturer’s workshop using water as fluid.
Manufacturer's design report certified by a Registered Professional or Professional Engineer.
